text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Admire Groove was listening to a 
playlist shared online—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(That's a nursery rhyme... one of the 
staff members used to sing to me long 
ago.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Their voice quality is similar... A very 
easygoing feel.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...She only vaguely remembered the second 
verse, so she'd always bluff her way 
through by humming it.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove got completely lost in a 
nostalgic song and ended up skipping 
training.
